turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Hi Marcus! Happy Monday. How is your week starting off in Portland?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hey! It's going well, thanks. Started the day a bit early. I actually had a nice warm bowl of oatmeal for breakfast to get me fueled up, which was perfect for the chilly morning.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Oatmeal is the perfect start for a November morning. Did you manage to squeeze in some exercise today too?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I did! I hit the gym weights today during my lunch break. Felt good to lift and get a solid workout in.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Great job making time for gym weights! How are things at the high school? Is the science department keeping you busy as head?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Oh, absolutely. Being head of the science department keeps me on my toes, especially now that we are well into the new school year. We're planning some lab upgrades right now.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: That sounds like a big project. Have you had any free time lately for your woodworking or tennis?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Not as much as I'd like! I haven't picked up my tennis racket in a couple of weeks, but I did spend a little time in my woodworking shop this past weekend working on a small shelf.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: A shelf sounds like a fun weekend project. How is Grace doing? Are you two still planning your trip to Japan for next spring?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Grace is doing great, thanks for asking. Yes, we are actively planning the Japan trip! We actually spent last night looking at hotels in Kyoto.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Kyoto is beautiful in the spring! It must be exciting to map out the itinerary.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: It really is. It gives us both something amazing to look forward to during these rainy autumn days. Anyway, I should get back to grading. Talk to you later!

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Have a great afternoon, Marcus. Good luck with the grading, and talk soon!
